termEs: Distancia en el plano de coordenadas
def: How far apart two points are on a grid.
defEs: Qué tan separados están dos puntos en una cuadrícula.
alt: Illustration of Distance on the Coordinate Plane: How far apart two points are on a grid.

def: How far apart two points are. It is never negative.
defEs: Qué tan separados están dos puntos. Nunca es negativa.
alt: Illustration of Distance: How far apart two points are. It is never negative.

def: How far a number is from zero.
defEs: Qué tan lejos está un número del cero.
alt: Illustration of Absolute value: How far a number is from zero.

def: How far apart two points are, left to right.
defEs: Qué tan separados están dos puntos, de izquierda a derecha.
alt: Illustration of Horizontal distance: How far apart two points are, left to right.

def: How far apart two points are, up or down.
defEs: Qué tan separados están dos puntos, hacia arriba o abajo.
alt: Illustration of Vertical distance: How far apart two points are, up or down.

def: A flat grid for placing points with two numbers.
defEs: Una cuadrícula plana para ubicar puntos con dos números.
alt: Illustration of Coordinate plane: A flat grid for placing points with two numbers.

def: A whole number or its opposite, like 2 and −2.
defEs: Un número de contar, su opuesto o el cero, como 2, −2 y 0.
alt: Illustration of Integer: A whole number or its opposite, like 2 and −2.

def: One of the four parts of a coordinate grid.
defEs: Una de las cuatro partes de una cuadrícula de coordenadas.
alt: Illustration of Quadrant: One of the four parts of a coordinate grid.
